title: Architecture Decision Record metadata
description: YAML front matter model for Qlik/Talend enterprise-architecture Decision Records. Pair with scripts/validate_adr.py, which enforces the Markdown body contract.

id.description: ADR-NNN for repository-level decisions, or SCOPE-ADR-NNN when scoped to a customer, program, platform, or workstream. Three-digit sequence. Never reused. XXX is tolerated as a deliberate placeholder by the validator but not by this schema.

yaml_version.description: Metadata model version this record follows.

title.description: Names the decision, not the topic. Preferred pattern: Use [approach] for [architecture role].

status.description: Governance weight of the record. Accepted is append-only from that point.

date.description: Date the decision was recorded or made.

review_by.description: Next planned review date, tied to a real cycle or milestone. Must be later than date.

decision_owner.description: Person or role accountable for the decision. Not necessarily the author.

contributors.description: People who contributed materially to the decision, option assessment, constraints, or review.

architecture_domain.description: The dominant domain affected, not every domain touched.

decision_scope.description: Boundary of the decision. Prevents a customer-specific decision being mistaken for reusable guidance.

decision_level.description: Strategic changes direction, Tactical selects a pattern for a known use case, Operational records a supportable operating choice.

confidence.description: Low is legitimate for Draft and Proposed. Never for Accepted.

technology_scope.description: Only products and technologies materially involved in the decision.

related_patterns.description: Supporting Knowledge Units. Preferred form: 'ID - Title (relative/path.md)'. Real IDs only.

related_adrs.description: Peer ADRs worth reading alongside this one. Not for relationships that are really supersessions.

impacted_architecture_views.description: Architecture views affected: Governance View, Data Flow View, Operational View, Security View, Platform Deployment View, or repository-specific views.

related_assets.description: Diagrams, design documents, playbooks, workshop outputs, assessments, templates.

supersedes.description: The ADR this one replaces. Null if original.

superseded_by.description: The ADR that replaces this one. Required when status is Superseded, otherwise normally null.

used_ai_to_prepare.description: Whether AI helped prepare, review, or refine the record. Provenance, not a weakness.

ai_solutions_used.description: Must be a non-empty list when used_ai_to_prepare is true, and null when false.
